1479-2841-6529-8101.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Wooded Foothills.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-6529-8101.description:
Fetch a land using Wooded Foothills.
When the fetched land enters, Curse of the Restless Dead and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Curse of the Restless Dead trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Curse of the Restless Dead from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

3617-4477-7370.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Greenwarden of Murasa.
Resolve Time Walk, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Greenwarden of Murasa from exile to the battlefield.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

129-1409-4068-6006.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
129-1409-4068-6006.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

1556-1987-2468-2751.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers.
Holding priority, activate Scorched Ruins by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}
Activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Panoptic Mirror's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Panoptic Mirror's trigger, casting a copy of Ghostly Flicker without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking Scorched Ruins and Strionic Resonator.
Repeat from step 2.

240-1322-5231-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing an Egg token, adding {R}
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3995-5963-7308.description:
Activate Marvin using Mona Lisa's ability by tapping it, adding an amount of colored mana equal to Marvin's power.
Activate Marvin using Horseshoe Crab's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2533-4050-4681-6913.description:
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning Chameleon from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
When Chameleon enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-5411-6662.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-5411-6662.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Chocobo Racetrack and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Need for Speed ability
Resolve the Chocobo Racetrack trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Chocobo Racetrack triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

3532-4997-5078-6595.notablePrerequisites: You control another Knight and/or Merfolk.
3532-4997-5078-6595.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Vodalian Wave-Knight triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Merfolk and/or Knight you control.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Lyse's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2173-4195-4211-4574.description:
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Resolve the Tormod's Crypt ability.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Tormod's Crypt from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

719-3053-3767-3918.easyPrerequisites: There are at least three basic land types among lands you control
719-3053-3767-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Prismatic Geoscope's ability by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1170-1492-2478-6862.easyPrerequisites: One of the artifacts must be in your hand, while the other is either in your graveyard or in your library.
1170-1492-2478-6862.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1170-1492-2478-6862.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Delivery Moogle.
When Delivery Moogle enters, it triggers, searching your library or graveyard for the other artifact and putting it into your hand.
Activate the artifact cast in step 1 by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

4050-4052-5544-6822.description:
Cast Forsaken Miner by paying {B}.
When Forsaken Miner enters, Kindred Discovery triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Forsaken Miner, adding {B}.
Resolve the Kindred Discovery trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Lyla triggers, targeting a creature an opponent controls.
Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Forsaken Miner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Lyla triggers.

864-4067-4851-6281.description:
Activate Timeless Lotus by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Eternal Witness.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Eternal Witness that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Eternal Witness token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Timeless Lotus.
Repeat.

222-527-969-5686.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-969-5686.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Shilgengar twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1069-1256-1753-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1256-1753-5499.description:
Activate Jade Mage by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Saproling.
Activate the Saproling by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia

313-1170-1749-2146-4113.notablePrerequisites:
Sea Tyrant of Segovia.
"Instant" chosen with Cloud Key.
You control at least one additional creature.
313-1170-1749-2146-4113.description:
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback by tapping Caetus, Vampire Hexmage and two other creatures you control.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Caetus and causing it to return to the battlefield as Invasion of Segovia.
When Invasion of Segovia enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Kraken creature tokens.
Activate Vampire Hexmage by sacrificing it, removing all counters from Invasion of Segovia.
Invasion of Segovia triggers, causing you to exile it and cast it as Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia.
Resolve Corpse Dance, returning Vampire Hexmage from your graveyard to the battlefield and returning Corpse Dance to your hand.
Repeat.

104-2390-3372.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to place a counter on a permanent or player.
Cleric Class is at least level two.
104-2390-3372.description:
Activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing All Will Be One to become an enchantment creature.
Place a counter on a permanent or player.
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent and causing you to gain two life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on any creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

2438-2506-2721.description:
Cast Bloodline Necromancer by paying {4}{B}.
When Bloodline Necromancer enters the battlefield, it and Molten Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Bloodline Necromancer trigger, returning a Vampire or Wizard creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Bloodline Necromancer.
Resolve the Molten Echoes trigger, creating a token copy of Bloodline Necromancer with haste.
When the token Bloodline Necromancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the nontoken Bloodline Necromancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-849-3705-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
Squee dies, triggering Anax, creating a 1/1 Satyr creature token.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Satyr, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Repeat.

2034-3356-4584.description:
Activate Masticore's first ability by paying {2}, dealing 1 damage to Polyraptor.
Polyraptor triggers, creating a token copy of itself.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the damaged Polyraptor, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

579-2645-4171-4547.notablePrerequisites: Staff of Domination and Kozilek's Channeler untapped.
579-2645-4171-4547.description:
Tap Kozilek's Channeler for {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Pay {3} and tap Staff of Domination to untap Kozilek's Channeler.
Pay {1} to Staff of Domination to untap it.
Repeat.

3230-3525-4644.notablePrerequisites:
Tidewater Minion does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Tidewater Minion.
3230-3525-4644.description:
Activate Coral Atoll by tapping it, adding {C}{U}.
Activate Tidewater Minion's last ability by tapping it, untapping Coral Atoll.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Tidewater Minion.
Repeat any number of times.
